test.create_query: CREATE TABLE text_index_dense_{codec} ( id UInt64, s String, INDEX idx s TYPE text(tokenizer = splitByNonAlpha, posting_list_codec = '{codec}') ) ENGINE = MergeTree ORDER BY id
test.fill_query: INSERT INTO text_index_dense_{codec} SELECT number, concat('thread k', toString(number % 64), if(number >= 5000000 AND number < 6000000, ' blk', '')) FROM numbers(10000000)
test.query: SELECT count() FROM text_index_dense_{codec} WHERE hasAllTokens(s, ['thread', 'k17'])
SELECT count() FROM text_index_dense_{codec} WHERE hasAnyTokens(s, ['thread', 'k17'])
SELECT count() FROM text_index_dense_{codec} WHERE hasAllTokens(s, ['thread', 'k17']) SETTINGS query_plan_optimize_count_from_text_index = 0, text_index_posting_list_apply_mode = 'materialize'
